name: Native Demo
description: Exercises every capability of native plugins and simulates the SDKs of cameras, maps, stores, ads and sign-in with the APIs of each platform alone.

bannerColor.description: Background of the native banner and the native screen, as "#RRGGBB".

urlScheme.description: URL scheme that opens the app, such as "haylendemo://hello".

cameraUsage.default: The Native Demo plugin asks for the camera to show how a plugin requests a permission and to simulate the camera of an SDK.
cameraUsage.description: Text of the camera permission prompt on Apple platforms.

microphoneUsage.default: The Native Demo plugin records the microphone to simulate the audio capture of an SDK.
microphoneUsage.description: Text of the microphone permission prompt on Apple platforms.

locationUsage.default: The Native Demo plugin reads the location to simulate the location and the map of an SDK.
locationUsage.description: Text of the location permission prompt on Apple platforms.

macDevices.description: Whether the macOS app signs with the entitlements of the hardened runtime that the camera, the microphone and the location need.
